You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 90f29f0eada4d60e1f6ae537502ddb2202b9540d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vladimir Oltean <vladimir.oltean@nxp.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jan 2020 19:18:28 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] enetc: Don't print from enetc_sched_speed_set when link goes
 down

It is not an error to unplug a cable from the ENETC port even with TSN
offloads, so don't spam the log with link-related messages from the
tc-taprio offload subsystem, a single notification is sufficient:

[10972.351859] fsl_enetc 0000:00:00.0 eno0: Qbv PSPEED set speed link down.
[10972.360241] fsl_enetc 0000:00:00.0 eno0: Link is Down

Fixes: 2e47cb415f0a ("enetc: update TSN Qbv PSPEED set according to adjust link speed")
Signed-off-by: Vladimir Oltean <vladimir.oltean@nxp.com>
Reviewed-by: Andrew Lunn <andrew@lunn.ch>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
---
 drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/enetc/enetc_qos.c | 1 -
 1 file changed, 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/enetc/enetc_qos.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/enetc/enetc_qos.c
index 00382b7c5bd8..0c6bf3a55a9a 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/enetc/enetc_qos.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/enetc/enetc_qos.c
@@ -36,7 +36,6 @@ void enetc_sched_speed_set(struct net_device *ndev)
 	case SPEED_10:
 	default:
 		pspeed = ENETC_PMR_PSPEED_10M;
-		netdev_err(ndev, "Qbv PSPEED set speed link down.\n");
 	}
 
 	priv->speed = speed;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by excessive logging of link-related messages when the network link went down, specifically from the `enetc_sched_speed_set` function. The function was incorrectly printing an error message indicating that the "Qbv PSPEED set speed link down" every time the link status changed to down, which was unnecessary and led to log spamming. The patch removes this redundant log message to prevent cluttering the logs with non-error notifications when a cable is unplugged.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by excessive logging of link-related messages when the network link went down, specifically from the `enetc_sched_speed_set` function. The function was incorrectly printing an error message indicating that the "Qbv PSPEED set speed link down" every time the link status changed to down, which was unnecessary and led to log spamming. The patch removes this redundant log message to prevent cluttering the logs with non-error notifications when a cable is unplugged.
